seasons.name: Birak
seasons.desc: Hot and dry — season of the young

seasons.name: Bunuru
seasons.desc: Warm easterly winds — season of adolescence

seasons.name: Djeran
seasons.desc: Cool and pleasant — season of adulthood

seasons.name: Makuru
seasons.desc: Cold and wet — season of fertility

seasons.name: Djilba
seasons.desc: Cold, lessening rain — season of conception

seasons.name: Kambarang
seasons.desc: Longer dry periods — season of the birth

seasons.name: Mangal
seasons.desc: First big rains — green tree frog appears

seasons.name: Ngaladan
seasons.desc: Cyclone season — storms from the ocean

seasons.name: Iralbu
seasons.desc: Hot period — after the wet season

seasons.name: Bargana
seasons.desc: Cool season — south easterly winds blow

seasons.name: Lalin
seasons.desc: Hot and humid — turtle mating season

seasons.name: Mangala
seasons.desc: First big rains — wet, hot and humid time of year

seasons.name: Marral
seasons.desc: Cyclone season — dragonflies appear and eat mosquitoes

seasons.name: Wirralburu
seasons.desc: Hot period — feel coolness coming in at night

seasons.name: Barrgana
seasons.desc: Cool season — turkeys are fat, time for hunting inland

seasons.name: Wirlburu
seasons.desc: Warming up — driest time of year, winds create wily-wily (dust devils)

seasons.name: Laja
seasons.desc: Hot and humid — return of rain, the heat and mosquitoes
